# E0303: a lens does not accept every instance of its source schema

A lens takes any instance of its source schema, in the field named after the
source version (v0_1 for a lens from 0.1), so it must accept every one of
them. A lens that constrains that field rejects some instances. Leave it as
`_`.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: int
				b?: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.1->0.0": {
		v0_1: {
			a: string
		}
		v0_0: {
			a: v0_1.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0303]: the input of lens 0.1->0.0 does not accept every instance of schema 0.1
   --> lineage.cue:19:3
    |
 19 |         v0_1: {
    |         ^^^^
    |
    = note: in thema's own CUE
     --> thema/lineage.cue:177:11
    = detail: field a not present in {a:int,b?:int}
              missing field "a"
    = help: v0_1 stands for any instance of its source schema; leave it as _
```
